config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-bl-ocs
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY' && ${header.mwPartnerCode} == 'POSTPAID'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.postpaid.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-bl/v1/paybill&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=403"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-bl/v1/reload&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=403"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-bl/v1/due&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=403"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=GET&path=/ocs-bl/v1/reload/{reference}&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200,404"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/ocs-bl/v1/reload/{reference}/reverse&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=403,404"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
